title: Define security requirements for software development
reason: The security requirements are recorded and known at every change: for the development infrastructure (PO.1.1) as blocking rules of the standard, each justified by a decision and checked by the gate on the exact head (no secret in the tree or in history, no production entrypoint run by hand, no force push); for the software (PO.1.2) as requirements, integrity (REQ-github-truth: main changes only through the merge queue with tower/gate green on the commit it judged) and privacy (REQ-web-lgpd-processing); and for third parties (PO.1.3) as the supply check's refusal of a high or critical advisory (supply.blocking_severities).
